Problem 1: Track Employee Salary Updates Objec(cid:415)ve: Create a trigger that logs any changes to an 
employee's salary. Task: 1. Create a table named SalaryHistory with the following columns: ○ Empno 
(INT) ○ OldSalary (FLOAT) ○ NewSalary (FLOAT) ○ ChangeDate (DATETIME) 2. Create a trigger named 
TrackSalaryUpdates that will insert a record into SalaryHistory every (cid:415)me the Sal column in the 
Employee table is updated. 
create table salaryhist(empno int, oldsal int, newsal int, changedate date(cid:415)me);

create trigger tracksalaryupdates 
a(cid:332)er update on employee 
for each row 
begin 
    if old.sal <> new.sal then 
        insert into salaryhistory (empno, oldsalary, newsalary, changedate) 
        values (old.empno, old.sal, new.sal, now()); 
    end if; 
end$$

 Task: 1. Create a table named DepartmentCount with the following columns: 
 ○ Deptno (INT) 
 ○ EmployeeCount (INT) 
 2. Write triggers to automa(cid:415)cally update the EmployeeCount whenever an employee is inserted or 
deleted in the Employee table.
